GoldenrodCity: Everyone knows a shortcut. On market days they all use the same one.
VioletCity: The monks walk so softly. The old tower does the creaking for them.
AzaleaTown: The well is older than the houses around it. We try not to hurry either one.
CherrygroveCity: When I give directions, I start with the sea. It has never moved across town.
NewBarkTown: It is a quiet place, apart from the wind off the water. I prefer a dry road and decent shoes.
MahoganyTown: People come for the lake. I stay for the quiet after they leave.
BlackthornCity: Everything here is uphill. Coming home included, somehow.
CianwoodCity: The sea brings visitors. The pharmacy takes care of the seasickness.
GoldenrodDepartmentStore: Shopping lists save time. So does remembering which pocket you put the list in. The counter has basic travel supplies.
GoldenrodUnderground: The market passage joins two streets. It is a dry route across town when the weather turns.
GoldenrodRadioLobby: We check the broadcast schedule twice. Silence is much more noticeable when a whole city is listening.
VioletAcademy: A status condition can matter as much as a strong attack. Watch speed, accuracy and the condition of your team.
NewBarkLab: These notebooks record local habitats and weather. A quiet morning is ideal for checking observations.
CianwoodPharmacy: Travelers seldom plan to feel seasick. Keep your supplies dry and read the label before using anything.
SafariReception: The walking grounds are open for visitors. Please stay on the marked paths and leave the reeds undisturbed.
SproutTower: The center pillar is built to sway. Take the outer walkway and keep the steps clear.
AlphChambers: The tablets are arranged by the shape of their markings. The labels describe how the ruins were surveyed.
UnionCave: The passage links the long northern road with Route 33. The lower chambers loop back to the main level.
SlowpokeWell: Keep the water clean. Even the smallest dropped wrapper travels farther than you think.
DarkCave: The branches reach three different roads. Read the entrance signs before you decide which way to leave.
MtMortar: Several mouths open onto Route 42. The higher passages connect inside the mountain.
IcePath: The ice panels are slippery. The walking ledges offer a careful way around them.
DragonsDen: People come here to train quietly and reflect. Please give the shrine and the water their space.
WhirlIslands: Four islands, many passages. Keep track of the ladders and the shore you entered from.
CliffEdgeGate: The coast path beyond the gate leads toward the cliffs and the valley road.
CliffCave: The upper and lower ledges meet inside. There is always a return by the same stairs.
TohjoFalls: The east passage ends at the regional boundary in this survey. The west steps lead back to New Bark.
